scope: Reconciles persisted component audits, including source-rerun dense SGP4-to-CPF comparison rows for four ILRS targets, checksum-linked full-night ZTF metadata, midpoint/exposure/edge trajectory ledgers, selected science-image profiles, held-out synthetic trail sensitivity, descriptive real-image path association against parallel lanes, the complete raw-source epoch/freshness comparison for the catalog grid, fresh AWP drag-to-CPF reproduction, and corrected-IERS-constant AWP-to-CPF comparison. It does not rerun the multi-day DOE or full-catalog episodes.

execution_qualifiers.note: The cloud-offloaded DUST archive was not reopened; this invocation reused its persisted checksum-linked independent source audit.

four_year_trajectory_latest_source_refre.scope_limit: Independent source replay is sampled at 500 successful states; row counts, keys, statuses, freshness semantics, and pinned-baseline deltas are checked across all 482472 rows.

four_year_all_catalog_source_epoch_vecto.cadence_and_scope_limit: One reconstructed SGP4 state per archived orbital-element epoch; epochs are irregular. This is the complete local source history, not a continuous fixed-cadence ephemeris or proof of operating status.

all_catalog_source_element_selection.scope_limit: Checks source epoch selection and freshness for every row; SGP4 vectors remain fully structural-audited and source-reproduced on stratified samples, not recomputed for all rows.

current_active_payload_common_epoch_snap.interpretation: Current snapshot extension only. It does not backfill history or establish operational status between archived element epochs.

replicated_center_lack_of_fit.interpretation: Independent center replication rejects the quadratic model for objective and custody; the fitted optimum is not validated.

awp_dust_persistence_monthly_sensitivity.interpretation: Burst-duration sensitivity using a DUST annotation-gap proxy; it is not a natural hardware failure estimate.

awp_durham_gap_parameterized_sensitivity.interpretation: Synthetic burst-loss sensitivity parameterized by conditional optical catalogue gaps; persistence is cadence-scaled to 60 s while preserving the stationary rate. Not a population-wide hardware dropout measurement.

all_catalog_four_hour_visibility_opportu.interpretation_limit: All-catalog geometric line-of-sight opportunities at four-hour samples from hypothetical current-active hosts assigned to the nearest monthly DOE host cohort; not observations, tasked opportunities, detection probability, or continuous visibility.

all_catalog_monthly_tasking_reference.method: SGP4 WGS-72 historical elements; streaming greedy urgency-minus-slew task assignment; shared seeded detection and outage random streams for paired conditions.

all_catalog_weekly_tasking_reference.method: SGP4 WGS-72 historical elements; streaming greedy urgency-minus-slew task assignment; shared seeded detection and outage random streams for paired conditions.
all_catalog_weekly_tasking_reference.interpretation_limit: Weekly one-hour samples of an all-catalog greedy tasking reference with synthetic injected burst loss; not continuous operations, the trained policy, or natural sensor reliability.

current_active_payload_monthly_tasking_b.interpretation_limit: Uses today’s active-GP/SATCAT classification backcast to archived historical elements; it does not establish historical operational status. The outage is injected and synthetic, and samples one hour per month.

all_catalog_monthly_tasking_seed_sensiti.interpretation: Added seed robustness for injected-loss effects across all catalog targets; does not provide natural hardware dropout rates or continuous historical operations.

all_catalog_quarterly_host_capacity_sens.method: SGP4 WGS-72; same greedy urgency-minus-slew scheduler as the full-catalog 6-host reference. Host IDs are nested prefixes of the maximum available dense-cluster selection for each date/regime.

all_catalog_monthly_host_capacity_sensit.method: SGP4 WGS-72; same greedy urgency-minus-slew scheduler as the full-catalog 6-host reference. Host IDs are nested prefixes of the maximum available dense-cluster selection for each date/regime.
all_catalog_monthly_host_capacity_sensit.interpretation_limit: Forty-eight monthly one-hour snapshots under hypothetical active sensor hosts and a greedy scheduler; outage is injected, not empirically observed.

matched_catalog_cohort_dropout_sensitivi.interpretation_limit: Paired synthetic 20% burst-loss sensitivity across different target populations; not measured physical sensor reliability or natural dropout effectiveness.

MOST_historical_tasking_outcomes.interpretation_limit: This is rare published evidence that attempted space-based satellite acquisitions can fail for command-upload, data-overwrite, power, and ground-station acquisition reasons. It does not measure an isolated camera dropout probability, does not cover the four-year catalog study period, and cannot calibrate the synthetic dropout model without resolving the attempt count and scope.

BUAA_MSOD_checkpoint_test.interpretation_limit: Benchmark metrics against released annotations only. They do not estimate planned-observation success, catalog-wide detectability, NORAD identity accuracy, hardware outages, or real dropout effectiveness. Empty/unmatched annotation frames are not verified negatives.

DUST_gap_interpolation_cross_validation.interpretation: This cross-validation estimates how well linear pixel interpolation recovers labeled positions when annotations are synthetically hidden. It does not identify an unlabeled source, validate catalog identity, prove an imaging attempt, or attribute gaps to sensor or algorithm dropout.

source_recomputed_target_window_capture_.estimand: missing nominal 1 Hz image slots divided by expected slots inside annotated RSO transit windows; not confirmed failed commanded captures
source_recomputed_target_window_capture_.interpretation_limit: Captures missing from the released timestamp/image record may reflect archive selection, scheduling, downlink, or acquisition; this is not a hardware failure probability. The annotated transit windows are selected on positive tracks.

DUST_image_cadence.interpretation: The timestamps contain gaps relative to the published 1 Hz cadence, including gaps inside annotated RSO transit windows. These are missing nominal image slots in the released record; without instrument command, power, downlink, or acquisition logs they cannot be attributed to hardware dropout or confirmed as attempted exposures. Unlabeled captured images also combine detector misses and annotation omissions.

DUST_timestamp_grid_custody_sensitivity.interpretation: This compares observed manual labels to optimistic counterfactuals on the nominal 1 Hz grid inside annotated first-to-last transit spans. Filling missing capture timestamps assumes a perfect RSO detection at each absent exposure; filling other unlabelled slots also assumes perfect annotation/detection. It quantifies conditional custody sensitivity in these 22 selected 2023 sessions, not sensor hardware failure probability or catalog-wide dropout effectiveness.

DUST_heldout_image_detection_sensitivity.method: For each held-out session, threshold at the 95th percentile of local-contrast background controls from all other sessions; score labeled positions, held-out background controls, and interpolated internal annotation gaps.
DUST_heldout_image_detection_sensitivity.interpretation_limit: A gap score above threshold shows local image contrast similar to held-out positive detections, not confirmed identity or proof the published detector would have registered it. Interpolated positions, selected annotated transits, semi-automated labels, and background contamination limit causal interpretation.

measured_sensor_sources.ILRS_interpretation: Observed sensor signal-quality association during acquired satellite laser-ranging passes. It is observational, conditions on recorded normal points, and is not a missed-acquisition probability or sensor dropout rate.

ZTF_Palomar_image_opportunities.interpretation: A small public-image sample contains likely catalog-associated streaks and one no-corresponding-trace case. It does not provide a calibrated detection probability or complete attempted-opportunity denominator.

full_night_image_profile_sample.interpretation: Profile measurements are image-level signal evidence only. They are not blinded independently truth-labeled detections, and the sample is selected on predicted catalog opportunities rather than a planned sensor attempt list. Do not report hardware dropout effectiveness from this audit.

heldout_injected_streak_sensitivity.interpretation: This is a controlled artificial-trail sensitivity test of the pixel-profile algorithm on held-out ZTF frames. It is not a satellite brightness model or independent truth label, and it does not measure natural satellite detection probability, observing-attempt completion, or hardware dropout effectiveness.

real_image_path_association.interpretation: Descriptive signal alignment against parallel lanes in 12 selected ZTF frames. Predicted catalog paths are not independent identity labels; image sample selection is conditioned on predicted opportunities; TLE errors and unrelated trails can create or hide alignment. This does not estimate satellite detection probability, planned attempt completion, or sensor dropout effectiveness.

ZTF_Palomar_fullnight_metadata.interpretation: Every midpoint-selected candidate and candidates outside the midpoint set were propagated over the exposure. A 12-image profile sample adds pixel-level signal measurements, but the crossings remain candidate opportunities without blind identity truth or a planned-attempt/nondetection denominator.

durham_widefield_optical_observation_gap.interpretation: A missing catalogue detection at a timestamp with another RSO detection is treated as an unrecorded target frame only when that NORAD object's path, linearly interpolated between adjacent high-confidence detections no more than 60 seconds apart, remains inside a conservative inscribed field-of-view circle. This is conditional on targets already detected on both sides of the gap. It measures catalogue continuity/extraction gaps, not shutter failures or a population-wide probability of missed acquisition.

cassiope_attitude_solution_dropout_telem.source: University of Calgary CASSIOPE/e-POP CAS_AttQuat daily definitive attitude product
limitations: CASSIOPE/Swarm-E is one instrumented spacecraft, not attitude history for the whole satellite catalog.
Code 0 identifies unavailable attitude solution intervals; it does not establish ground-sensor missed-task rates.
The source handbook notes long dropouts are represented with NaN quaternions; source codes also distinguish star sensors and coarse sensor solutions.

cassiope_empirical_one_minute_dropout_pr.interpretation: One-spacecraft attitude-solution availability pattern sampled at the tasking simulator's one-minute cadence. It can drive a sensor-profile sensitivity case, but is not an estimate of ground-sensor missed acquisitions or fleet-wide failure probability.

nearest_definitive_solution_spacing_seco.note: Minimum absolute Time_To_Previous/Next at the sampled epoch; this is a source-solution spacing proxy, not a quaternion error bound.

limitations: The one-minute sample is taken at the first second of each minute to match the tasking replay cadence.
The handbook gives nominal source uncertainties, not per-sample covariance or pointing residuals.
A valid quaternion or nearby definitive solution does not establish ground-sensor task success.
Only one spacecraft has this open four-year telemetry stream.

awp_j2_against_ilrs_cpf.interpretation: CPF is an operational reference product, not independent orbit truth. This is a model-to-operational-product consistency comparison and does not calibrate sensor dropout.

awp_j2_drag_against_ilrs_cpf.interpretation: CPF is an operational reference product, not independent orbit truth. This is a model-to-operational-product consistency comparison and does not calibrate sensor dropout.

fresh_recomputed_awp_j2_drag_against_ilr.interpretation: Fresh AWP numerical integrations exactly reproduced the archived position rows and summary metrics for four ILRS CPF targets; this confirms reproducibility, not physical-model accuracy.

awp_iers_earth_constants_against_ilrs_cp.interpretation: Using IERS Earth constants corrects most of the AWP error for three high-altitude ILRS targets; SGP4 remains closer for all four sampled targets, and Starlette remains poorly matched.

dense_historical_sgp4_against_ilrs_cpf.interpretation: CPF operational prediction products are a strong external consistency reference but not independent orbit truth. Results cover these four laser-ranged objects and the available CRD/CPF overlap; they do not establish accuracy for the full satellite catalog or other orbit classes.

dust_anchored_detection_dropout_sensitiv.interpretation: These base-probability levels are anchored to the DUST benchmark conditional annotation-continuity proxy: 98.90% labeled frames within annotated transit spans, with 95% session-cluster bootstrap interval 97.62%-99.72%. Transit endpoints are defined by detections and internal gaps may be annotation omissions, obscuration, or track behavior. These levels are a bounded scenario anchor, not calibrated detection probabilities or catalog-wide hardware estimates.

buaa_recall_anchored_detection_dropout_s.interpretation: Base-probability values are rounded lower 95% bound (0.8374), point estimate (0.9549), and upper 95% bound (0.9974) of held-out MSAMNet label recall on 64 BUAA-MSOD sequence groups. They are scenario inputs only, not calibrated detection probabilities for GoDSAT simulated sensors or the four-year satellite catalog. Optical image-detection labels and simulator range/staleness response are different sensor domains; range and staleness penalties remain modeled assumptions.

dust_annotation_gap_burst_persistence.interpretation: Empirical annotation-gap persistence proxy for a bounded burst-process sensitivity. It is not a sensor hardware failure probability; unlabeled frames may reflect obscuration, annotation omission, or track behavior.

remaining_gaps.note: The catalog ephemeris covers all catalog objects at four-hour cadence, but catalog-wide attitude histories are unavailable; the new CASSIOPE telemetry is one spacecraft only. The trained DOE policy uses 18 targets; separate greedy references replay all fresh targets for one hour at 208 weekly dates and 48 monthly dates with six hosts, with an added second random seed for the monthly capacity experiment, and at 17 quarterly dates with nested six/12/up-to-24-host teams. These are not continuous four-year operations, and active-host history is backcast from a current snapshot. CASSIOPE attitude-solution dropout is not a ground-sensor missed-attempt denominator; sensor payloads and injected tasking dropout remain hypothetical.
